cwe_content.cwe: CWE-22,Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

candidate.Reason: The function directly joins user-controlled input (filename) with a base directory (PATH_NOTE_ATTACHMENTS) without proper path traversal checks, allowing potential access to files outside the intended directory.
The function constructs file paths using user-controlled input (filename) without proper path traversal checks, potentially allowing access to files outside the intended directory.
The function uses user-controlled input (filename) to construct file paths without proper path traversal checks, potentially allowing access to files outside the intended directory.
